title: Hotfix: prevent KV cache corruption on mid-stream retry (runtime)
author: Aditya Rao
description:
Context: During INC-2026-02-02 (stream aborts + elevated 5xx), we saw a crash loop in the runtime triggered by mid-stream retry when the router replays the request after upstream disconnect. Root cause appears to be KV cache slot reuse after an exception path, leading to invalid pointer deref in the attention kernel.

This PR is a minimal hotfix:
- Guard KV cache slot reuse when a stream is retried
- Ensure the retry path allocates a fresh slot and invalidates previous references
- Add a regression test that simulates retry after partial decode

Rollout/rollback:
- New runtime image tag will be runtime:hotfix-2026-02-02a
- Canary: Hosted us-west-2a @ 10% for 15 min
- Rollback criteria: +0.2% error rate or any new CrashLoopBackOff

- [x] SBOM + provenance generated by workflow
